en: The devil's blood has driven you mad...
No! Absolutely not, Diana.
You too will understand, once you have touched Satan-sama's majesty.
His blood turns all pain into pleasure...
I have no words left that could speak to you as you are now...
Indeed, words cannot explain it. Such splendor...
Learn it with your own body.
Angel Badly Hurt
Well, little lady, why the scary face?
You're Viper, aren't you? I've come to have you return the Demon Stone!
Whoa, whoa, don't make it sound so bad. Someone handed this over to me.
If that means you got it by deceiving Rocus, I forgive you even less!
Now, calm down, little lady. And if you know Rocus, all the more reason I can't lie to you.
Fine. I was only doing this as a favor anyway. I'll give it back.
Then, right now!
No, not to you, little lady. To the angel.
You're there, aren't you? Angel.
I know it's really you who wants it.
Viper's Trap
This has nothing to do with the angel. Hand the Demon Stone to me! Viper!
Tch! If the angel won't come out, I can't hand this over.
This is my last bit of fun, you see. So long!
Battle with Serenis
Magic
Demon Stone (start)
Demon Stone (blink)
Demon Stone (red)
Demon Stone Stand
Heh heh heh, welcome, hero of the angel.
The Empire's witch... I know that you're the root of all this.
And what will you do now that you know? You can't stop me.
Stay right there, hero of the angel.
I'll show you a great power reborn.
Emperor, the time has come to offer the last soul to the Demon Stones.
Just as in the legend, you will become the Heavenly Dragon and give the world a new birth.
Serenis... What are you...
There's nothing to fear, Emperor. You will become one with eternal life...
Now... let us begin...
You're the witch who used Ion...
Oh my, you're the hero from that time.
Serenis Battle (after)
Awakened Endymion
Chair
N-no...
Heh heh heh heh... This is how justice ends.
The witch stopped moving?
Devil
Ngh, defying me at the very end, this woman...
Well, I was growing bored of this body anyway... Just as well.
Lowly angel, don't get cocky just because you killed one vessel...
Ngh, at the very last moment...
Well, I was growing bored of this body anyway... Just as well.
Hmm... Not bad at all.
Angels! Now that the Heavenly Dragon has been revived, whatever you do is useless!
With this Heavenly Dragon, the incarnation of Satan-sama's soul, I shall return to Cocytus...
But before that, I'll take every soul in this world as nourishment for the Heavenly Dragon...
Learn how powerless you are... angel!
Ha ha ha ha ha. Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha.
Savio Battle
Savio (normal)
Don't tell me... you're being used by that witch too?
I don't see it as being used. She gave me this armor... She gave me new power...!
But I'll tell you no more... There's no point talking to someone about to die...
Clarence Battle
Angel's hero, huh... Seeing people like you... makes my skin crawl...
Why do you fight? Please, stop this senseless thing!
Hmph, that's none of your business, little lady.
This world's nothing special. I'd feel better if it was just gone.
Here I come, hypocrite.
Will you run this time too? Or will you fight?
Hmph, I ain't running.
I can't let you get in the way of my last bit of fun, little lady.
Last Battle (preamble)
Heavenly Dragon
What do you want? Angel, and the angel's hero...
Have you come to beg for mercy?
No.
We've come to stop the destruction and chaos you bring.
What an amusing thing to say...
You'll defeat me and the Heavenly Dragon? Ha ha ha ha ha!
Do not underestimate Satan-sama's power, or mine!!
You humans and your guardian angel are mere nourishment to the Heavenly Dragon...
We exist on a different plane...
Not once has a devil's word ever been the truth...
I have no intention of listening to you any longer.
Foolish... But perhaps that foolishness is what makes you human...
Very well, I'll show you the difference...
Ha ha ha!!! Do you think you can destroy me?
I'm not like Gaap!
Last Battle (eaten)
Well? Do you understand now?
This is the power of a ruler.
You could not have left a single scratch on me, not even laid a finger on me.
This power... this very power is the proof that we shall rule over all!
The name of god exists for us...
Learn your place, arrogant angel.
But... we know the mercy of a king...
The great mercy that only the noble possess.
Angel, do you not wish to save this hero's soul?
Come to us as a messenger of the new god, and I shall forget all you have done and save you and this hero.
Having touched our great power, you understand now, do you not? Which side is right, and which is wrong.
Now, answer.
Will you serve us, or be devoured by the Heavenly Dragon along with this hero and vanish?
I understand...
No...
...Yes... I understand... I will become your messenger...
Please... save her soul, save her life...
Heh, splendid. A fine spirit...
Then... I shall save this hero...
Cecia!!!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha! Yes! That look... the look of your despair...
I wanted to see that face, the face of one who has lost everything!
Truly, the foolishness of you angels is beyond saving...
Now, I'll put you inside the dragon together with your hero...
Die.
No... I am an angel... I cannot sell my soul to a devil...
She believed in me, an angel, and fought for me. I will not let you use her soul or mine.
Hmph, what impertinence...
Very well.
You too shall die and become balm for Satan-sama's soul.
Wait, Beelzebub...
You call me by my true name...
How could I forget those red eyes of yours, or your filthy tricks...
That voice... this aura!!
It's been a long time, Lord of the Flies.
Michael! Raphael!
Forgive me for being late, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
I knew that a day like this would come when Satan's dragon was revived...
And how great the power of the fallen angel lurking in the shadows was...
We can't leave Beelzebub and Satan's Heavenly Dragon to you alone.
Let's defeat them together.
Now, hero, rise again.
...Light?
Hero of the world below, show the devil the strength of humans once more.
No matter how many of you gather, this human can never defeat me!
Last Battle (lose)
...Ngh, Satan-sama's soul... has come to this...
This is justice, Beelzebub.
Hmph, what are you saying... Don't get cocky... over something like this...
For now, I shall withdraw... But one day, Satan-sama will surely be revived...
And he will lead the demon armies and burn your Heavens to the ground...
...Satan-sama, I will revive you without fail... Together we shall pass through the gates of the Heavens...
Wait for it... angels...
Zombie & Ghoul
I have no name to give a monster.
Here I come!!
Ngh, a hunter... You...
I have questions for you.
Do you know Ravenruft?
The name of our king... How could I not know it?
...I see... your scent... your air...
Why do you, who inherit the king's blood, side with humans...
Where is he... Where is he?
If you want to go to the king's castle, go north...
But I doubt you'll ever reach it...
Our king would never let a traitor like you live...
I am... human...
Clive-sama... Will that terrible vampire come again?
Say... Clive-sama?
Clive-sama...
Gorgon
Heh heh, turning down an invitation from such a beautiful woman... You're a failure as a man.
It seems you've gone somewhere you can't come back from.
Yes, that's right.
I offered myself to Ravenruft-sama of my own will.
For him, who grants eternal life and beauty... I would do anything...
You who oppose the king... I shall dispose of you here.
Vampire
Hmm... It seems the gift from your father was wasted.
Who are you?
My name is Blas. I've come to see you as the king's messenger.
But... to think the child from that time would grow so big.
I thought you'd died in a ditch somewhere.
What?
You wouldn't remember, I suppose.
When we attacked your village, you were the only one I let go.
It was you!!!
Ugh... ngh!
Ha ha ha ha, it seems you're weaker to the urge of anger than to the lure of sweet blood.
But that is the greatness of the king's blood.
